name: sky-todo-launch-day
goal: Add dark mode with a toggle, live search filtering, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts (n = new, / = search, ? = help), due-date badges, and fix the overdue-calculation and date-sorting bugs in src/lib/dates.ts.

features.summary: Dark mode with a persisted toggle.
Live search filtering over the todo list.
Help sheet listing the shortcuts, gated on shortcuts.
Fix the overdue calculation and due-date sorting.
Due-date badges on todo rows, gated on the date fix.

notes: The 3-minute demo path: seven capabilities (six feature folders plus the date fix), with a ±1 task tolerance for the 7-task shape. Nothing edits the shared renderer or the shell.
